{{Quote|Basic rule of xenoarchaeology: You don't unleash a foreign technology into a population center, especially one with a man-machine interface.|Captain Golah|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Xenoarchaeologist.jpg|thumb|200px|A xenoarchaeologist]]
'''Xenoarchaeology''' was the study of vanished [[Alien/Legends|alien]] cultures through the scientific analysis of the artifacts left behind.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|341}}</ref> It was closely related to [[xenosociology]].

Known xenoarchaeologists included the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Suz Tanwa]],<ref name="Yavin: The Big Red One">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040722yavin|text=Yavin: The Big Red One|int=Yavin: The Big Red One}}</ref> the [[Brizzit]] [[Tzizvvt]],<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|tzizvvt|Tzizvvt}}</ref> the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Blibbie]],<ref name="hitc">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Head in the Clouds}}</ref> and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] doctors [[Anki Pace]],<ref name="Dark Tide I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref> [[Fasha Dansun]],<ref name="Wildfire">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Wildfire (adventure)|book=The Kathol Outback}}</ref> [[Angrail Ryhl]],<ref name="Heroes and Rogues">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> [[Henrietya Antilles]], [[Garv Debble]], and [[Milanda Vorgan]]. Dr. [[Shilaea Motacc]], an experienced amateur in archaeology, was a professional of different sciences.<ref name="hitc" /> The [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahin]] were considered xenoarchaeologists, though they only researched their own possible ancestors, the [[Eellayin/Legends|Eellayin]].

The worlds of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] were especially attractive to xenoarchaeologists, as they contained exotic artifacts and advanced technology since lost to [[The galaxy/Legends|the wider galaxy]].<ref name="HoloNet News">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_1.html|Dooku Spotted in Gree Enclave}}</ref>

Several governments had organizations devoted to xenoarchaeology. The [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was involved in the field, while the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had a [[New Republic Xenoarchaeology Division]].

==Behind the scenes==
A xenoarchaeologist was one of the templates in ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', a sourcebook for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.
